notes.title: Shadows of Souls: Regular Update – Bug Fixes and Gameplay Enhancements
notes.notes:
Hello, Shadows of Souls players!

As a solo developer, I’m dedicated to making the best game possible. This update includes:

Bug Fixes: I’ve tracked down and fixed every issue I could find.

Gameplay Enhancements: Improved performance and small tweaks for a better experience.

Your support keeps this journey alive, and I’m grateful to have you along for the ride. Thank you for playing Shadows of Souls!

Warm regards,
Ayfjay
